chunks: From him, from Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: "When a man embraces Islam, he must undergo circumcision, even if he is eighty years old."
ai.seo_question: Is circumcision obligatory for adult male converts to Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the obligation of circumcision (*khitan*) for adult male converts, emphasizing that age is not a barrier to this Sunnah. It reflects the practical application of the Prophet's tradition in early Islamic history, where adult companions like Khawwat ibn Jubayr underwent circumcision upon conversion, reinforcing its status as a fundamental rite of entry into the fold of Islam.
